research_method: bounded research only to resolve the recorded promotion question; original Stage A score/caps are not inflated merely because stronger sources were found

decisions.reason: Asahi Kasei confirms internal-cell improvement and planned customer PoC/licensing, but independent validation, cycle-life/manufacturability and commercial adoption remain unresolved.

Bounded research resolves the execution/scale gap: Liontown executed a binding farm-in with a staged earn-in to 100%, US$40m project expenditure over four years and initial consideration of US$5m cash plus US$10m shares; counterparty independently confirms the binding agreement and project footprint.
California SB 913 had cleared the legislature and was enrolled/sent to the Governor, but was not yet signed/chaptered at the review cutoff; final-policy gate remains open.
Critical Metals' transaction remained a proposed scheme subject to court, shareholder and other conditions; no completed acquisition is established.
Wonjun-Silvatex establishes a strategic partnership and phased U.S. LFP-base plan, but no binding site/capex/commercial-production commitment sufficient for strict execution is established.
Korea's ferry battery-safety plan is official and operationally specified, but its narrow passenger-carriage scope does not lift the existing decision-value score to the strict threshold.
The all-solid-state consortium/R&D kickoff and 2027 target remain pre-commercial; customer qualification or commercial-scale production is not established.

Bounded research found existing METI/JOGMEC support mechanisms and individual investments but did not verify a new final Japanese policy matching the reported generic direct-government mine-acquisition claim.
Suzuka construction start is verified, but the project is only about 1.995MW/8.358MWh; execution is real while independent strategic scale remains below the strict threshold.

Issuer-level interim filings plus independent demand evidence resolve the earnings-source gap: multiple lithium producers reported stronger H1 results while Albemarle quantified sharply higher lithium demand driven primarily by stationary storage. The original score remains 60; promotion reflects evidence resolution, not score inflation.
The Mt Cattlin report describes an expected/ongoing sale and bidding process, not a signed sale or selected buyer; execution remains unresolved.

SunScout signed a definitive agreement, but project closing/revenue realization remains conditional on acquisition completion, RTB milestones, regulatory approval and financing; original score is also below strict threshold.

MOTIE confirms the battery-triangle governance meeting and candidate infrastructure projects, but the solid-state/sodium/recycling/power projects remain under review with planning to be supplemented; no final execution/budget anchor is established.

Lead Intelligent describes mass-production-grade solid-state equipment and customer use, but the material commercialization claim remains principally company-sourced without named independent customer qualification; original score remains below strict threshold.
The KRW2.5tn supply-chain/resource-security package is part of the 2027 government budget proposal, not enacted appropriations; the final-policy/funding gate remains open.

The RMB222m lithium-equipment procurement contract is disclosed, but effectiveness is conditioned on both signatures and receipt of a 30% purchase price; that condition is not verified and the original score is below strict threshold.
